title: Bank Deposit Pricing in the Euro Area
authors: Ugo Albertazzi, Finn Faber, Alessandro Gavazza, Oana-Maria Georgescu, Ernest Lecomte
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the pricing of bank deposits in the Euro area during 2007--2024. We document that the pass-through of policy rates to sight deposit rates is low, asymmetric, varies across countries, and decreases over time. We estimate an equilibrium model of bank deposit markets, and find that depositors' price sensitivity exhibits large heterogeneity across EU markets and over time. Rate-sensitive depositors switched to higher-yielding savings products, decreasing the rate-sensitivity of the remaining pool of sight deposits and increasing banks' market power, accounting for the sluggish pass-through following the 2022 European Central Bank's rate hikes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2007至2024年欧元区银行存款的定价机制。我们记录到，政策利率向活期存款利率的传导呈现低水平、非对称性、跨国差异显著且随时间递减的特征。通过构建银行存款市场均衡模型进行估计，发现存款人的价格敏感度在欧盟各市场及不同时期存在显著异质性。对利率敏感的存款人转向收益率更高的储蓄产品，导致剩余活期存款池的利率敏感度下降，银行市场势力增强，这解释了2022年欧洲央行加息后传导机制迟滞的现象。

title: A New Wave of Industrial Policy in Asia-Pacific: Could Resurgence lead to Structural Transformation?
title_zh: 亚太地区产业政策新浪潮：复苏能否引领结构转型？
authors: Paula Arias & Vanya Georgieva & Rahul Giri & Maria González-Miranda & Mr. Ashique Habib & Anne-Charlotte Paret & Tatjana Schulze & Arthur Xie & Weining Xin & Yichen Xu & Dilan Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides a first comprehensive assessment of industrial policy (IP) across Asia‑Pacific and its potential to enable structural transformation. Building an IP database for 2009–2024, paired with a rich dataset, the paper documents a large wave of IP interventions. Subsidies dominate, followed by import-limiting measures. Novel applications of machine‑learning and clustering approaches to assess IP targeting suggest that, ex-ante, about three-quarters of IP could align with structural transformation strategies, including relatively safe (“safe-bets”) and risky (“moonshots”) strategies promoting technological upgrading and diversification, and strategies to alleviate market‑frictions and distortions in key sectoral nodes. IP’s ex-post linkages to trade, competitiveness, and domestic firms’ indicators are small and short‑lived; sustained gains that could lead into structural transformation appear only sporadically. Our findings underscore the need for a more parsimonious and carefully‑designed IP—anchored to targeting clear market‑failure rationales and complemented by ambitious structural reforms—potentially enhancing effectiveness and lowering net costs.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统评估了亚太地区的产业政策及其推动结构性转型的潜力。通过构建2009-2024年产业政策数据库，并结合丰富的数据集，本文记录了大规模的产业政策干预浪潮。其中，补贴政策占据主导地位，其次为进口限制措施。采用机器学习与聚类分析等创新方法对产业政策靶向性进行评估后发现，事前来看，约四分之三的产业政策可能与结构性转型战略相契合，包括促进技术升级与多元化的相对稳健型策略及高风险策略，以及缓解关键行业节点市场摩擦与扭曲的策略。产业政策在事后与贸易、竞争力及国内企业指标的关联性较弱且持续时间短暂；能够持续推动结构性转型的收益仅零星出现。研究结果强调，需要制定更精简且精心设计的产业政策——以明确的市场失灵原因为靶向，并辅以雄心勃勃的结构性改革——从而可能提升政策有效性并降低净成本。

title: Market Segmentation through Information
title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分
authors: Matthew Elliott, Andrea Galeotti, Andrew Koh, Wenhao Li
abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。

title: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
title_zh: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示
authors: Nils Christian Hoenow, Gunther Bensch, Michael Kirk
abstract: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
abstract_zh: 在土壤肥力较低的地区，小农户常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。当森林再生缓慢时，这种模式会加剧问题，导致局部森林损失及气候变化、生物多样性下降等全球性环境挑战。本文基于一项框架田野实验，探讨不同货币激励类型如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们针对25个村庄的518名小农户开展了一项公共池资源博弈实验：森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且无即时再生。实验分为三个阶段：无激励基线期、干预期（参与者分别获得个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或零激励（对照组））以及激励后阶段。该设计使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励取消后的持续性。所有激励类型均比基线期减少了砍伐行为，但并未显著优于对照组——对照组砍伐量同样下降，这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计特征相关。激励效应在取消后基本消失，未发现持久的动机挤入或挤出效应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度支付可能不足以在持续性资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地看，本研究凸显了在田野实验室研究中纳入控制条件、谨慎设计实验框架并进行多维度分析的重要性，同时需警惕将结论推广至其他情境或政策应用。

title: Automation, Migration, and Development: Geography of Job Precarity in South Asia and North Africa
title_zh: 自动化、移民与发展：南亚与北非地区工作不稳定的地理分布
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚及北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业和城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构区域和国家间的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结论揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下技术驱动增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

title: Second Order Approximation of Dynamic Models with Time-Varying Risk
title_zh: 时变风险动态模型的二阶近似
authors: Pierpaolo Benigno, Gianluca Benigno, Salvatore Nistico
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides first and second-order approximation methods for the solution of non-linear dynamic stochastic models in which the exogenous state variables follow conditionally-linear stochastic processes displaying time-varying risk. The first-order approximation is consistent with a conditionally-linear model in which risk is still time-varying but has no distinct role - separated from the primitive stochastic disturbances- in influencing the endogenous variables. The second-order approximation of the solution, instead, is sufficient to get this role. Moreover, risk premia, evaluated using only a first-order approximation of the solution, will be also time varying.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了求解非线性动态随机模型的一阶和二阶近似方法，其中外生状态变量遵循具有时变风险的条件线性随机过程。一阶近似与条件线性模型一致，在该模型中风险虽仍具有时变性，但在影响内生变量方面并未发挥独立于原始随机扰动的独特作用。而解的二阶近似则足以体现这一作用。此外，仅使用解的一阶近似评估的风险溢价也将呈现时变性。
